_: Everything the Swift and Kotlin packages can do to a document. The bridge runs these, and scripts/generate.mjs writes the typed Swift and Kotlin methods from them, so the three stay in step. Types: string, int, double, bool, with ? for optional.

commands.name: typeText
commands.doc: Types at the caret, replacing any selected text.

commands.name: pasteText
commands.doc: Pastes plain text; line breaks become new paragraphs.

commands.name: paste
commands.doc: Pastes what a clipboard offered, keeping formatting: HTML (a web page, Word, Google Docs), else RTF (Pages, TextEdit), else tab-separated text as a table, else the text.

commands.name: splitBlock
commands.doc: Enter: splits the paragraph at the caret.

commands.name: backspace
commands.doc: Backspace.

commands.name: deleteForward
commands.doc: Delete.

commands.name: deleteSelection
commands.doc: Deletes the selected text.

commands.name: undo
commands.doc: Undoes the last change.

commands.name: redo
commands.doc: Redoes the last undone change.

commands.name: toggleBold
commands.doc: Turns bold on or off for the selection, or for the next typed text at a caret.

commands.name: toggleItalic
commands.doc: Turns italic on or off.

commands.name: toggleUnderline
commands.doc: Turns underline on or off.

commands.name: toggleStrikethrough
commands.doc: Turns strikethrough on or off.

commands.name: toggleCode
commands.doc: Turns the code style on or off.

commands.name: toggleSuperscript
commands.doc: Turns superscript on or off.

commands.name: toggleSubscript
commands.doc: Turns subscript on or off.

commands.name: setTextColor
commands.doc: Sets the text color, such as "#b91c1c". Null removes it.

commands.name: setHighlight
commands.doc: Sets the highlight color. Null removes it.

commands.name: setFontFamily
commands.doc: Sets the font, such as "Georgia". Null goes back to the document's.

commands.name: setFontSize
commands.doc: Sets the font size in points. Null goes back to the document's.

commands.name: setLink
commands.doc: Links the selected text to an address. Null removes the link.

commands.name: clearFormatting
commands.doc: Removes formatting and styles from the selection.

commands.name: setParagraph
commands.doc: Makes the selected blocks ordinary paragraphs.

commands.name: setTitle
commands.doc: Makes the selected blocks the document title style.

commands.name: setSubtitle
commands.doc: Makes the selected blocks the subtitle style.

commands.name: setHeading
commands.doc: Makes the selected blocks headings of level 1 to 6.

commands.name: setQuote
commands.doc: Makes the selected blocks quotes.

commands.name: setCodeBlock
commands.doc: Makes the selected blocks code blocks.

commands.name: toggleBulletedList
commands.doc: Makes the selected blocks a bulleted list, or ordinary paragraphs if they already are.

commands.name: toggleNumberedList
commands.doc: Makes the selected blocks a numbered list, or ordinary paragraphs if they already are.

commands.name: setAlignment
commands.doc: Aligns the selected blocks: left, center, right or justify.

commands.name: indent
commands.doc: Moves the selected blocks in.

commands.name: outdent
commands.doc: Moves the selected blocks out.

commands.name: setListMarker
commands.doc: Sets how the selected lists are marked: numbers, letters or roman numerals for a numbered list, a symbol for a bulleted one. Null goes back to the default for the depth.

commands.name: setListStart
commands.doc: Numbers the first selected item of a numbered list with `start` and carries on from it: restarts a list at 1, or starts it at any number.

commands.name: continueNumbering
commands.doc: Takes the selected numbered items back into the numbering of the list above them, undoing a restart.

commands.name: setLineSpacing
commands.doc: Sets line spacing as a multiple of the font size, such as 1.5. Null removes it.

commands.name: setSpaceBefore
commands.doc: Sets the space above the selected paragraphs, in points.

commands.name: setSpaceAfter
commands.doc: Sets the space below the selected paragraphs, in points.

commands.name: insertTable
commands.doc: Inserts a table at the caret.

commands.name: addRowAbove
commands.doc: Adds a table row above the one the caret is in.

commands.name: addRowBelow
commands.doc: Adds a table row below the one the caret is in.

commands.name: addColumnLeft
commands.doc: Adds a table column left of the one the caret is in.

commands.name: addColumnRight
commands.doc: Adds a table column right of the one the caret is in.

commands.name: deleteRow
commands.doc: Deletes the selected table rows (the table, if that is every row).

commands.name: deleteColumn
commands.doc: Deletes the selected table columns (the table, if that is every column).

commands.name: deleteTable
commands.doc: Deletes the table the caret is in.

commands.name: mergeCells
commands.doc: Merges the selected cells (a selection from one cell to another) into one.

commands.name: splitCells
commands.doc: Splits merged cells in the selection back into single cells.

commands.name: setHeaderRow
commands.doc: Turns a table's first row into a header row, or back.

commands.name: setCellShade
commands.doc: Shades the selected cells, such as "#fef08a". Null clears it.

commands.name: setColumnEdge
commands.doc: Moves the edge between a table's column and the next one, to `position` (0 to 1, from the table's left edge). The neighbouring columns trade width; the others keep theirs. With `merge` true the change joins the previous undo step, so a drag is one step to undo.

commands.name: setRowHeight
commands.doc: Sets the least height of a table's row, in points. Null lets it fit its content. With `merge` true the change joins the previous undo step, so a drag is one step to undo.

commands.name: insertPageBreak
commands.doc: Inserts a page break at the caret.

commands.name: insertDivider
commands.doc: Inserts a horizontal rule at the caret.

commands.name: insertImage
commands.doc: Inserts a picture at the caret from a data: URI or an address, shown at width by height in points of 1/96 inch.

commands.name: setImageSize
commands.doc: Sets the size a picture is shown at, in pixels. With `merge` true the change joins the previous undo step, so a drag is one step to undo.

commands.name: setImageCrop
commands.doc: Crops a picture: how much to cut away from each edge, as a share of the whole picture (0 to 0.9). All zeros shows all of it again. The picture's scale stays the same, so cutting an edge makes it smaller on the page, as it does in Word. With `merge` true the change joins the previous undo step, so a drag is one step to undo.

commands.name: setImageWrap
commands.doc: Makes text wrap around a picture, which sits at the left or right edge, or puts it back on a line of its own with null. A picture in a table cell stays on its own line.

commands.name: deleteImage
commands.doc: Deletes a picture.

commands.name: setDocumentTitle
commands.doc: Renames the document.

commands.name: applyParagraphStyle
commands.doc: Sets the named paragraph style of the selected paragraphs. Null takes it off.

commands.name: applyCharacterStyle
commands.doc: Sets the named character style of the selected text. Null takes it off.

commands.name: createStyle
commands.doc: Makes a named style from the selection and applies it. Returns its id.

commands.name: deleteStyle
commands.doc: Removes a style and takes it off the text that used it.

commands.name: select
commands.doc: Selects text. Offsets are UTF-16 units into a block's text.

commands.name: selectAll
commands.doc: Selects the whole document.

commands.name: setSuggesting
commands.doc: Turns suggesting mode on or off. False when the current user may not suggest.

commands.name: acceptSuggestion
commands.doc: Accepts a suggestion.

commands.name: rejectSuggestion
commands.doc: Rejects a suggestion.

commands.name: acceptAllSuggestions
commands.doc: Accepts every suggestion the current user may accept.

commands.name: rejectAllSuggestions
commands.doc: Rejects every suggestion the current user may reject.
